answer: The mesa of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Every claim climbs the voyage of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the juniper re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, reduced by each unverified claim, no identity may audit its own recruit. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce.
